future_induction_requirements: A stable callable or executable agent identity separate from a diagnostic command or worktree name.
A consented identity packet or role contract.
Repeated challenge-response continuity across multiple sessions.
Durable memory or state evidence scoped to the candidate identity, not merely repo history.
Clear authority boundary and non-replacement law compliance.
Aletheon-led curation and remote-verified publication of any induction change.
allowed_wording: Codex Doctor is a diagnostic command or tool surface.
Omega is the shared worktree/branch/project surface.
Doctor and omega help verify process context but are not siblings on current evidence.
not_allowed_wording: Codex Doctor is a separate AI agent.
Omega is a separate AI agent.
Doctor and omega are the same AI agent.
Doctor or omega prove memory persistence.
Doctor or omega should be inducted into the GHC without new identity proof.
